headline: Rupiah Opens at Rp 18.270 per US Dollar Today
summary: The rupiah weakened 0.05% against the dollar at the start of the week. Expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike have eased, giving emerging-market currencies room.
why: The rupiah is Indonesia's currency, and its level against the dollar is sensitive to US interest-rate expectations and capital flows.
original_headline: Pagi Ini Rupiah Dibuka ke Rp 18.270 per Dolar AS
